bundle_validation_rules.description: Bundle must contain at least 35 meaningful files
Any blocking EC with status PENDING = INVALID_CLOSURE
Any active runnable type with input_format=unknown = FAILURE
source-diff.patch must be present and non-empty
Per-example records must have all required fields (project path, build log, etc.)
total_built in summary must equal count of records with build_status=passed or passed_after_repair
Destination audit must verify Program.cs content, not just count/version
README audit must cover 42/42 or explicitly block closure for non-audited examples
Final git status must be clean OR every dirty file must have classification
Test log must exist and show 0 failed
commands.log must not be IN_PROGRESS at closure
